title: Weyerhaeuser Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results
body_markdown:
SEATTLE


, Oct. 29, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / --[Weyerhaeuser Company](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=2404310364&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2F&a=Weyerhaeuser+Company) (NYSE: WY) today reported its third quarter 2026 financial results. The company's earnings release and associated materials are available on the[Investors section](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=1120324715&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.weyerhaeuser.com%2F&a=Investors+section) of the company's website,[www.weyerhaeuser.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=1628560597&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2F&a=www.weyerhaeuser.com) . In addition, the earnings release has been furnished on a Form 8-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and is available at[www.sec.gov](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=2291237312&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.sec.gov%2F&a=www.sec.gov) .


**EARNINGS CALL INFORMATION** The company will hold a live webcast and conference call at 7 a.m. Pacific (10 a.m. Eastern) on October 30, 2026, to discuss third quarter results. To access the live webcast and presentation online, visit the[Investors section](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=1120324715&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.weyerhaeuser.com%2F&a=Investors+section) on[www.weyerhaeuser.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=1628560597&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2F&a=www.weyerhaeuser.com) on October 30, 2026.


To join the conference call from within North America, dial 877-407-0792 (access code: 13755109) at least 15 minutes prior to the call. Those calling from outside North America should dial 201-689-8263 (access code: 13755109). Replays will be available for two weeks at 844-512-2921 (access code: 13755109) from within North America, and at 412-317-6671 (access code: 13755109) from outside North America.


**ABOUT WEYERHAEUSER**
[Weyerhaeuser Company](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=2404310364&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2F&a=Weyerhaeuser+Company) , one of the world's largest private owners of[timberlands](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=1251332708&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2Ftimberlands%2F&a=timberlands) , began operations in 1900 and today owns or controls more than 10 million acres of timberlands in the U.S., as well as additional public timberlands managed under long-term licenses in Canada. Weyerhaeuser has been a global leader in sustainability for more than a century and manages 100 percent of its timberlands on a fully[sustainable](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=2554342588&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2Fsustainability%2F&a=sustainable) basis in compliance with internationally recognized sustainable forestry standards. Weyerhaeuser is also one of the largest manufacturers of[wood products](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=31240736&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2Fwoodproducts%2F&a=wood+products) in North America and operates additional business lines around product distribution,[climate solutions](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=3626007703&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2Fclimate-solutions%2F&a=climate+solutions) ,[real estate](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=3499438208&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2Fland%2Fcontact-us%2F&a=real+estate) , and energy and natural resources, among others. In 2025, the company generated $6.9 billion in net sales and employed approximately 9,500 people who serve customers worldwide. Operated as a real estate investment trust, Weyerhaeuser's common stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol WY. Learn more at[www.weyerhaeuser.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4810177-1&h=1377110498&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.weyerhaeuser.com%2F&a=www.weyerhaeuser.com) .
